findings.title: Named current root consumer still authorizes with the candidate checker
findings.evidence: Design requires CI to extract and run the unique merge-base checker with an explicit repository-root bind, fail closed on a missing checker, and never fall back to candidate bytes (current-contract-design.md:33-35). The same design then leaves protocol-v3-author-authorization.yml:30 as a current root consumer that runs the in-tree candidate `check-protocol-v3-freeze.mjs` with no base argument, no merge-base --all uniqueness check, and no PROTOCOL_V3_FREEZE_REPOSITORY_ROOT bind (red-proposal.md:59). Host branch protection is neither changed nor verified, so this job is a live candidate-authority path. Exact fix: retarget this freeze step onto the same merge-base extraction/fail-closed contract as registry.yml, or explicitly name it integrity-only and state it is not transition authorization.
findings.violated_requirement: CI loads the unique merge-base checker; no candidate fallback; author-authorization remains a current root consumer

findings.title: Pacemaker bootstrap suite is not given the same fail-closed supersession as seal
findings.evidence: Pacemaker supplementReady() is true only when the live checker exits 0 (phase-5d-pacemaker-law-red.test.ts:564-581). After the stale tuple is repaired, skipIf(!SUPPLEMENT_READY) lifts and the previously skipped suite runs, including absent-base bootstrap success at :941-944 and CHECKER_WITHOUT_BASE_BOOTSTRAP at :966-976. Seal's isomorphic skipped cases are required to execute with retitled fail-closed predicates (current-contract-design.md:114-115; red-proposal.md:19). Pacemaker is only called a static discovery and 'not claimed executed' (current-contract-design.md:110-111; red-proposal.md:38), so GREEN may keep pacemaker.yml:51-59 candidate bootstrap or skip the suite. Exact fix: require the pacemaker readiness/bootstrap cases to execute after repair, retitle the bootstrap predicate, and replace absent-base success with fail-closed current acceptance, same as seal.
findings.violated_requirement: Honest historical-test supersession; seal/pacemaker relinquish bootstrap authority; a readiness skip is not acceptance

findings.title: Live seven-field field-list owners need an explicit historical-vs-executed disposition
findings.evidence: The current W0 registry already lists optional authorShareMultiplier first (registry-v1.json:57). Live executable checkers still require the old seven names (blueprint-work-budget-v1/check-freeze.mjs:154-167 and blueprint-operation-budget-v1/check-freeze.mjs:148-162). RED retargets the work-budget test at :289-298 and forbids treating spec.md:157 as a current seven-field claim, but does not classify these checkers as historical-not-executed after successor retirement or as current predicates to retarget. If freeze keeps executing them, they reject the signed W0 registry.
findings.violated_requirement: Full active consumer coverage; do not omit a subsystem because its old checker understands only seven fields; successor artifacts remain historical, not an alternative live route
